method: The harness calls IDXGIAdapter3::QueryVideoMemoryInfo(node 0, DXGI_MEMORY_SEGMENT_GROUP_LOCAL) for the calling process after harness initialization, after the material upload, at scene start and after every rendered frame. The recorded peak is the maximum CurrentUsage over those samples; it is process usage, not adapter capacity and not ResidencyPolicy bookkeeping.
adapterDedicatedMeaning: adapter capacity reported by DXGI; not a use figure and not substituted for the measured peak
